title: Shift Parallelism: Low-Latency, High-Throughput LLM Inference for Dynamic Workloads
summary_zh: Snowflake 的 production-oriented 多 GPU inference runtime。核心觀察是 sequence parallelism 在 inference 中可保留 KV cache invariance，因此 runtime 能在低流量時使用 TP 降低 latency，在高流量時切到 SP 提高 throughput。相較 TP-only，interactive response 最高加速 1.51×，batch throughput 最高提升 50%；bursty trace 中 TTFT 由 DP 1355 ms、TP 3930 ms 降至 148 ms。
summary_en: Snowflake's production-oriented multi-GPU inference runtime. The key observation is that sequence parallelism can preserve KV-cache invariance in inference, allowing the runtime to use TP for low-traffic latency and SP for high-traffic throughput. Compared with TP-only serving, it reports up to 1.51× faster interactive response and 50% higher batch throughput; in bursty traces, TTFT drops from 1355 ms for DP and 3930 ms for TP to 148 ms.
